text:
zoe: Heads-up team — we have a coordinated marketplace listing for APAC next week. Need owners for press embargo, localized microsite swap, SI quickstarts, and HW partner gating. Who can take what?

liam: I'll take press & media outreach. Draft PR in Drive: https://drive.google.com/marketplace-apac-draft. We need final partner quotes and a short boilerplate paragraph.

maya: I can own microsite swap and localization checks. i18n is ~95% done; final proofread scheduled with @l10n-team at 09:20 PT. We'll need to ensure mobile tile rendering for partner badges.

frank: I'll cover SI quickstarts and integration docs. Plan to add two sample snippets (Python + curl) and link to GA SDK. Also will coordinate the Partner X onboarding doc.

pm-bot: NOTE: cutover job queued: marketplace-apac-cutover-2026-06-21. Steps = validate assets -> flip feature flag -> CDN invalidate -> run smoke tests. Dry-run recommended.

zoe: Proposed timing: embargo lift 08:45 PT (00:45 SGT), blog at 01:00 SGT, microsite swap 01:15 SGT, partner emails 01:30 SGT. Thoughts?

liam: Prefer to lift embargo 20 mins before blog so APAC reporters can prep. Recommend lift 00:50 SGT, blog 01:05 SGT, swap 01:15 SGT. Also will include UTMs: utm_source=partner_marketplace&utm_campaign=apac_launch.

maya: Sequence makes sense. On swap, I'll set Cache-Control: max-age=0 and issue a targeted purge for /marketplace/* to avoid old hero assets. I'll post a small runbook to #eng-oncall with the exact CDN purge command.

frank: SI badges: partner legal okayed integration badges for integration pages but NOT for homepage hero. We'll surface badges on partner detail pages only. Also confirming code snippets point to stable SDK docs.

zoe: Legal gating status? Any HW partners blocking?

pm-bot: Partner legal signoffs: HW-R: pending (asset HW-R-12), HW-T: approved (signed_2026-06-10). Contact for HW-R legal: legal_contact@hw-r.com.

liam: If HW-R can't sign in time, we'll show a neutral placeholder tile reading 'Partner tile pending' with a link to partner details. That avoids blocking the swap.

maya: I'll prepare a placeholder component in the design system so swap logic can fall back cleanly. Also will ensure alt text and accessibility labels are set.

pm-bot: Reminder: maintenance window at 6391119000. Any cutover should finish before that.

zoe: Good call. Keep final swap at least 45m before maintenance. Final owners: zoe (overall), liam (press & UTMs), maya (microsite & l10n), frank (SI docs). Action items: 1) legal chase HW-R (zoe) 2) final partner quotes (liam) 3) runbook + dry-run (maya + pm-bot) 4) SI snippet PR (frank). Reply here when done.

liam: Sent embargo times and media list to reporters. Added UTM list to the press kit.

maya: Dry-run completed on staging — found path mismatch for hero image; fixed and redeployed. Will run final dry-run 30m prior.

frank: SI quickstarts PR merged. Docs available at docs.redwood.com/partners/si-quickstart.

pm-bot: HW-R legal responded: partial signoff granted, but requested restricted usage for hero images (web only, not paid ads). Asset uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-assets/hw-r/pack-v3.

liam: Updated press kit to reflect usage constraints and added partner quote from SI-2.

maya: Placeholder component ready. CDN purge command for cutover (example):
```bash
aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E1EXAMPLE --paths "/marketplace/*"
```
I'll run this as part of the cutover job and set a 20-minute rollback window using feature flag gating.

cdn-bot: Cutover job marketplace-apac-cutover-2026-06-21 scheduled at 01:15 SGT. Preflight checks green. Monitoring hooks: latency (p50/p95), 5xx rate, and partner page availability.

zoe: Final checklist before go: 1) legal logo approvals (zoe) 2) press embargo + UTMs (liam) 3) blog + press assets ready (liam) 4) staging dry-run green (maya) 5) SI docs live (frank). Reply when complete and we'll proceed. :white_check_mark:

liam: Press kit updated and embargo lift notification queued.

maya: Final dry-run at 00:45 PT — all checks passed. Runbook posted to #eng-oncall.

frank: SI docs live and linked from press kit.

zoe: HW-R legal okayed hero use for web only at 00:10 SGT. Assets confirmed. Going to #launch-room for cutover comms. Thanks team — this thread is our source-of-truth. :rocket:
